featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought my car from Solitaire Andheri and used to happily get them maintained at their next door service centre in Andheri.But since they closed down the Andheri Service facility I have to trudge all the way to Borivali for even the smallest repair.I don't like taking my car to the local mechanics and I am not fond of the Viva service station at Goregaon either.The Solitaire Service Hub at Borivali is cramped and doesn't have enough space to service all clients. During rains it's a pathetic sight inside and I marvel at the parking techniques of the personnel deployed for the same. Because of the limited space the turnaround time also is much much more than what used to be at the Andheri facility.The technicians are ALL top notch and still manage to do the job satisfactorily.It's just that this place looks run down and doesn't give the premier look of the Andheri West facility.The approach road to the service centre is in scary condition for most part of the year and people living in good neighbourhoods elsewhere would not want to visit this shabby facility unless absolutely necessary.Solitaire should also not levy extra charges on credit cards for payments in line with practices followed by Toyota.
Honda builds simple solid cars with sound enngines and I absolutely adore this philosophy.My experience with Solitaire Andheri sales and support also has been fantastic. However,I will not consider buying another Honda from Solitaire unless they come up with a service station with adequate space near Oshiwara or Lokhandwala.
Luckily I found my old service advisor Sahid Ahmed once again at the Borivali facility.The poor fellow had been sacked by the management following the closure of the Andheri facility.Am glad that he has been reinstated.Shahid is an honest bloke and very affable.He got my small job done without much ado and I left a happy customer.
